description: Minimum footing area and thickness for a post or column from Table 9.15.3.4. (house) or from the 2.4 kPa deck load over 75 kPa soil, the minimum post size from Article 9.17.4.1., and the minimum foundation depth from Table 9.12.2.2. of the 2024 Ontario Building Code. Source: 2024 Ontario Building Code (O. Reg. 163/24), Division B, Articles 9.15.1.1., 9.15.3.3. to 9.15.3.8., 9.4.2.3., 9.4.4.1. (Table 9.4.4.1.), 9.12.2.2. (Table 9.12.2.2.) and 9.17.1.1. to 9.17.4.1.

attached.description: Deck only: is the deck attached to a house or another structure?

beam_span_ft.description: Deck only: supported beam length, half the sum of the beam spans on both sides of the post, in feet. At most 10 ft. Unit: ft.

column_spacing_ft.description: House only: spacing of the columns along the beam, in feet. The table is for 3 m (9.8 ft) and the area is adjusted in proportion (Article 9.15.3.7.). Unit: ft.

deck_area_m2.description: Deck only: deck area in square metres, for the floating deck check in Sentence 9.12.2.2.(7). Unit: m2.

drainage.description: Soil drainage to at least the depth of frost penetration.

floors.description: House only: number of floors the column supports.

heated.description: Does the foundation contain a heated space (house)? Decks, porches and unheated space: no.

height_mm.description: Deck only: distance from ground to the underside of the joists, in millimetres. Unit: mm.

high_water_table.description: Is the water table less than the footing width below the bearing surface? It doubles the footing area on gravel, sand or silt (Article 9.15.3.4.(3)).

joist_span_ft.description: Supported joist length, in feet: half the sum of the joist spans on both sides of the beam. House: at most 16 ft (4.9 m). Unit: ft.

kind.description: house (interior column or post under a beam in a building) or deck (post under a deck or porch beam).

roof_over.description: Deck only: does the deck support a roof?

soil.description: Soil or rock at the footing (Table 9.4.4.1.).
